mapper.insert: insert into catering_set(name, month_price, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{name}, #{monthPrice}, 0, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from catering_set where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select * from catering_set where name = #{name} and del_flag = 0

select cs.*, (select string_agg(d.name, ',') from set_dishes sd left join dishes d on sd.dishes_id = d.id where sd.set_id = cs.id) as dishes_names from catering_set cs where cs.del_flag = 0
and cs.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by cs.create_time desc
